meta.name: viral-post-writer
meta.description: Write viral social media posts that promote affiliate products naturally. Use this skill when the user asks anything about writing social media content for affiliate marketing, creating posts for LinkedIn/X/Reddit/Facebook, promoting a product on social media, writing affiliate content, or mentions "viral post", "social media post", "content for affiliate". Also trigger for: "write a post about X", "help me promote X on LinkedIn", "create a thread about X", "make a Reddit post for X", "draft tweets for X", "social media content for affiliate program", "how to promote X on social", "write something that goes viral", "LinkedIn post for affiliate", "X thread about this tool", "help me sell X naturally on social media".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 写出能自然推广产品的社交媒体爆款帖子
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为联盟产品编写有吸引力的社交媒体内容，让推广更自然。
copy.tagline_en: Write viral social media posts that naturally promote affiliate products
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create engaging social media content for affiliate products and promote them naturally.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude会帮你撰写推广联盟产品的社交媒体帖子。它会自动选择病毒式框架、适配平台格式（LinkedIn、X、Reddit、Facebook），并添加FTC披露。
howto.when: 当你要求写推广联盟产品的社交媒体帖子，或提到“viral post”、“social media post”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一条推广HeyGen的LinkedIn帖子。
say.note: 会生成LinkedIn格式的帖子，包含FTC披露。
会使用“真实推荐”框架，适配Reddit风格。
会生成问题-解决方案线程，包含多推文。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude writes social media posts to promote affiliate products. It auto-selects a viral framework, formats content for the specified platform (LinkedIn, X, Reddit, Facebook), and includes FTC disclosure.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to write social media posts promoting affiliate products, or mention keywords like "viral post", "social media post", etc.

say_en.text: Write a LinkedIn post promoting HeyGen.
say_en.note: Generates a platform-adapted post with FTC disclosure.

say_en.text: Create a Reddit recommendation for Notion.
say_en.note: Uses 'Genuine Recommendation' framework, tailored to Reddit.

say_en.text: Make an X thread about Semrush.
say_en.note: Creates a problem-solution thread with multiple tweets.
